title: syngramma spathulata
intro: Syngramma spathulata, commonly known as the 'Rattlesnake Fern', is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function, due to its therapeutic actions such as being an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
